pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Sub-polygonal dark-tan contiguous regions exhibiting smooth edge gradients and rounded vertices. Spatial distribution shows a mix of medium and large area patches on the upper flank, transitioning to smaller geometries towards the lower extremities.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-tan pathways forming a topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily tri-valent and tetra-valent intersections. Pixel thickness of the corridors is relatively uniform, showing minimal variance in the unobstructed central regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the superior neck presents a high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette with a consistent 1D geometric contour against the background.
